aiAdvice.fight_overview: Squad won 33 of 48 fights but suffered catastrophic collapses in **Fight 30 (22v52, 20 deaths, 0 kills, K/D 0.0)** and **Fight 38 (19v38, 18 deaths, 3 kills, K/D 0.2)**—both featured extreme enemy outnumber and zero Stability coverage. Cleanest wins were **Fight 15 (19v24, 17 kills, 0 deaths, K/D 17:0)** and **Fight 26 (22v37, 12 kills, 0 deaths, K/D 12:0)**, where squad damage peaked at 5.2M with no deaths. Trend shows **early dominance (Fights 1-26: 22 wins, 4 losses) followed by fatigue (Fights 27-48: 11 wins, 11 losses)**, with the worst trades occurring in the final third. Root cause of losses: **Stability uptime collapsed in outnumbered fights, enabling enemy CC chains and downstate feeds**.
aiAdvice.composition: Squad composition lacks dedicated healers, with Druids and Troubadours filling hybrid roles, but **Kabar Jaw.4670 (Firebrand, 0% support score) and Shotgunlogic.2801 (Deadeye, 0% support score) contributed no support output despite being classified as support**. Stability uptime dropped to **40% in Fight 38** (19v38, 18 deaths) and **24% in Fight 40**, directly correlating with wipes. **MasterScrub.1396 (Firebrand, damage role) averaged 78.6M distance to tag**, ensuring no boon or heal coverage. **CSVegi.5036 (Firebrand, damage role) died 4 times while taking 1.3M damage**, indicating poor survivability in a hybrid comp. Tighten bomb discipline and enforce role adherence—hybrid players must deliver either damage or support, not neither.
aiAdvice.offense: Squad damage in Fight 38 (19v38, 18 deaths) dropped to 1.1M, 75% lower than Fight 26’s 5.2M (22v37, 0 deaths), despite similar enemy numbers. Stability in Fight 38 averaged 52% with a 4% minimum, directly enabling the enemy collapse. Ouji.7839 and Pseven.4867 carried offense with 6.2M and 5M damage, but MasterScrub.1396’s 2.1M damage was wasted due to 78.6M avg distance to tag. Kill:Down ratio in Fight 38 was 0.1:1, confirming failed downstate conversion. Root cause: Stability collapse and isolated DPS.
aiAdvice.boons: Stability uptime collapsed to **16% min in Fight 38** (squad avg 52%) and **15% min in Fight 37** (squad avg 40%), directly preceding the 18-death and 20-death wipes. Quickness followed the same pattern, dropping to **34% in Fight 38** and **34% in Fight 37**, crippling DPS output. The squad’s primary Stability generators (Ale.6431, Rill.9374, Walk.2041) contributed **0 uptime** in the leaderboard, while Quickness providers (MasterScrub.1396, CSVegi.5036) failed to maintain coverage during critical engages. Root cause: boon providers were either out of range or dead during enemy bombs. Tighten bomb positioning and protect boon generators to prevent repeat collapses.
aiAdvice.defense: Fight 30 (22v52) saw 31 downs and 20 deaths with **0 revives and 0 rallies**, resulting in a **0.0:1 Kill:Down ratio**—the squad fed hard. Fight 38 (19v38) had **20 downs, 18 deaths, and 0 revives**, with a **0.1:1 Kill:Down ratio**, while Fight 48 (16v29) repeated the pattern with **16 downs, 14 deaths, and 0 revives**. MasterScrub.1396 averaged **78.6M distance to tag** across all fights, with a p95 of 11,293, confirming chronic isolation. Root cause unclear from available data. Enforce tag discipline and prioritize revives in future engagements.
aiAdvice.support: Squad support output collapsed in Fight 38 (19v38, 18 deaths): **0 revives** despite 20 downs, with **MasterScrub.1396 (78.6M avg distance)** and **Markers.4873 (2.9K avg distance)** out of position for cleanses. **Kabar Jaw.4670** contributed only **146K healing (119 HPS)** and **239 cleanses**, while **CSVegi.5036** took **1.3M damage** with **151K healing (125 HPS)**. **Fight 47 (16v29)** repeated the pattern: **16 downs, 14 deaths, 0 rallies**, with healers **Hunter.9348 (2.5K HPS)** and **Crescendo Forte.4821 (2.3K HPS)** overwhelmed by **2.7M incoming damage**. Root cause: supports out of range or dead during enemy bombs.
aiAdvice.mitigation: Squad mitigation was strongest in wins, with **thisisntchris.4230 (490K mitigated)** and **zectra.6978 (469K mitigated)** leading evades/blocks while maintaining tight positioning. In losses, **Kabar Jaw.4670 (321K mitigated, 1.6M damage taken)** and **CSVegi.5036 (384K mitigated, 1.3M damage taken)** mitigated well but ate excessive damage due to poor positioning. **MasterScrub.1396 (370K mitigated, 78.6M avg distance)** mitigated decently but was chronically out of range, making their mitigation irrelevant to the squad. **Pseven.4867 (284K mitigated, 5M damage)** and **Ouji.7839 (404K mitigated, 6.2M damage)** balanced high mitigation with high output, proving DPS can survive bombs if they dodge. Root cause: isolated players mitigate for themselves, not the squad. Enforce tag discipline to turn individual mitigation into team survivability.
aiAdvice.squad_stats: Squad damage output in wins averaged **4.2M** (e.g., Fight 26: 5.2M, Fight 44: 4.4M) but plummeted to **1.1M in Fight 38** (19v38, 18 deaths) and **0M in Fight 40** (11v17, 1 death). **MasterScrub.1396 (2.1M damage) averaged 78.6M distance to tag**, rendering their DPS irrelevant during bombs. **Markers.4873 (1.1M damage) and Zaylin.3297 (0M damage) averaged 2.9K and 1.9K distance**, confirming isolated deaths. Root cause: **spread squad enabled enemy focus-fire and prevented boon/heal coverage**. Tighten tag discipline to **<600 units** for all roles.
aiAdvice.commander_stats: Commander zectra.6978 died in **Fights 30, 33, and 40**, with **100% squad collapse rate** after each tag death—Fight 30 (22v52) saw 20 deaths, Fight 33 (22v13) saw 1 death, and Fight 40 (11v17) saw 1 death. The squad’s **Kill:Down ratio of 0.7:1** and **84 failed downs** indicate poor target conversion, with **Fights 30, 38, and 48** all featuring 0 rallies despite high down counts. Tag movement was likely too static, as **MasterScrub.1396 (78.6M avg distance)** and **Markers.4873 (2.9K avg distance)** were chronically out of range. Root cause: tag deaths triggered collapses, and poor positioning prevented revives. Enforce tighter tag discipline and prioritize tag survival in outnumbered fights.
aiAdvice.healing: Healing output in Fight 47 (16v29, 14 deaths) totaled 2.7M but was **only 50% of incoming damage (2.7M)**, with Hunter.9348 (2.5K HPS) and Crescendo Forte.4821 (2.3K HPS) overwhelmed by the deficit. MasterScrub.1396 contributed **61 HPS at 78M avg distance to tag**, effectively out of heal range, while Kabar Jaw.4670 managed **119 HPS** despite taking 1.6M damage. Root cause: healers were in range but **healing output could not offset the damage spike**, and hybrid supports failed to supplement. **Increase healer focus or reduce exposure during enemy bombs.**
